selection_rule: An additional index of aliases containing prepared/delivery/landing/fill naming, plus captured current7/current8. This is not the census filter: every available ref name was included regardless of naming.
source_path_scope: TCSlib/**/*.lean plus TCSlib.lean for all available ref/worktree HEAD trees; current records campaign loose source/patch data also searched. Exchange orphan trees with no TCSlib source have zero source files; archives and unavailable remote revisions are outside this source-text census.
